scope: All P0/P1 application work and UI QA; actual external ERP/treasury/calendar connections deferred by user. No real-world dispatch is simulated as completed.

gaps.title: Live preview lacks the strategy dataset
gaps.acceptance: The selected release has the intended 10 commitments with honest live/estimated coverage, source-backed plan comparators, calendar and executive policy inputs; the run completes and all visible values trace to that exact pack.

gaps.title: Local release aligned; remote and hosted release identity remain open
gaps.acceptance: A clean checkout of the designated release recreates the approved application and selected data contract; rollback explicitly covers code, schema compatibility and selected run.

gaps.title: Zero values disappear from Plan Health
gaps.acceptance: A higher-is-better 0/100 contributes 0%; a lower-is-better zero uses the approved bounded rule; missing input remains visibly missing.

gaps.title: Drift and direction depend on dataset labels and IDs
gaps.acceptance: Rename/reorder KPI IDs and change periods without changing results; mutate actuals without editing labels and verify the correct exception; validate weights against the ratified plan.

gaps.title: Grounded synthesis accepts fabricated additional numbers
gaps.acceptance: Adversarial provider responses retaining valid numbers while adding, changing or attaching false units, amounts or causes are rejected. All displayed numerical cells resolve to an approved calculation.

gaps.title: Authority enforcement is weaker than its published contract
gaps.acceptance: Negative tests across users, personas, aliases, mixed-domain questions and /qa versus /assistant/chat demonstrate identical denials before restricted data is loaded.

gaps.title: Shared multi-tenant run isolation is incomplete
gaps.acceptance: Two tenants and two BUs sharing infrastructure cannot list, resolve, retrieve, search, export or ask about each other’s records, including guessed IDs and latest aliases.

gaps.title: Frozen board memory is not demonstrated as an immutable snapshot
gaps.acceptance: Close a meeting, change/reprocess current company data and restart services; the meeting’s figures, files and answers remain identical and inaccessible data stays unavailable.

gaps.title: Live sign-out does not invalidate the session
gaps.acceptance: After sign-out the same cookie cannot access a protected route; the response and browser navigation agree, including proxy and branch deployments.

gaps.title: Question-bank reporting does not measure the required answer quality
gaps.acceptance: The latest approved release answers at least 45 of 50 questions sampled across all 18 themes correctly with resolving citations and no fabricated numbers; publish the failed and refused questions separately.

gaps.title: Portable datasets fixed; external-service acceptance remains open
gaps.acceptance: Clean CI executes the enrichment assertions, service-dependent security/transaction tests, and required CEO/board journeys; unexpected skips fail the release gate.

gaps.title: A reusable strategy-to-KPI compiler is missing
gaps.acceptance: Onboard a second anonymized company without code changes; prove target extraction, owner review, formula binding, recompile diffs and unsupported-input handling.

gaps.title: Intent Vault and governed amendments are missing
gaps.acceptance: Intent is reachable from navigation; every commitment exposes approval and last amendment; at least three real amendments resolve; every diagnostics KPI links to its plan version.

gaps.title: Production connectors and incremental ingestion are missing
gaps.acceptance: Repeated and out-of-order source deliveries are idempotent; transactions, nightly bank balances and calendar updates arrive at their declared cadence with visible freshness and failure state.

gaps.title: Continuous drift and historical Plan Health remain partial
gaps.acceptance: New measurements automatically change drift state, historical trajectory and alerts; stale connectors and stopped workers visibly degrade readiness; slow KPIs do not fake daily movement.

gaps.title: Cross-system entity resolution and consolidation need broader proof
gaps.acceptance: A multi-system corpus covers aliases, shared bank accounts, disputed matches, intercompany sweeps and FX-rate dates; every aggregate reconciles without double counting.

gaps.title: Recovery meter is limited to the first eight decision rows
gaps.acceptance: Adding a ninth eligible recovery changes the meter correctly; shuffling rows does not; partial receipts and reversals reconcile to payment evidence.

gaps.title: Working-capital drift uses settlement-day proxies
gaps.acceptance: Compare both metrics with a finance-reviewed example containing large unpaid balances; disclose formulas, weighting and windows and prove cash-impact reconciliation.

gaps.title: Cost-of-drift conversion is a limit, not a completed feature
gaps.acceptance: Financial drift reconciles to the variance bridge; nonfinancial conversions cite approved factors; missing factors produce a precise missing-input request, never an invented number.

gaps.title: Decision Velocity is not implemented
gaps.acceptance: A recorded decision and subsequent verified first action update the correct metric; overdue open items remain visible; source events drill through from the card.

gaps.title: Recording a decision is not closed-loop execution
gaps.acceptance: Retries cannot duplicate delivery; failures remain pending with a clear owner; a task closes only when authoritative completion evidence arrives.

gaps.title: Agent experiences are not one continuous state model
gaps.acceptance: One real request traces through delegation, evidence, approval and result; refresh/restart/another authorized device preserves the same task and conversation state.

gaps.title: Configured vector search is still a lexical/hash fallback
gaps.acceptance: A held-out corpus with paraphrases, entity aliases and Arabic/English queries meets agreed recall@k and citation precision targets without cross-scope leakage.

gaps.title: CFO and BU experiences are not a complete four-persona product
gaps.acceptance: Persona changes alter data scope, responsibilities and workflow, not just labels; direct URLs cannot substitute another persona’s header or access rights.

gaps.title: Deployment policy exists; tier proof and visible residency do not
gaps.acceptance: The screen matches actual deployment configuration; blocked egress cannot trigger an unapproved fallback; each supported local model passes the answer-quality gate.

gaps.title: Arabic/RTL support and complete accessibility acceptance are absent
gaps.acceptance: Core intake, diagnostics, drill, chat, decision and board journeys work in Arabic and English with keyboard and screen reader; exported figures preserve units and meaning.

gaps.title: Application rollback is not a tested data recovery plan
gaps.acceptance: Restore into a clean environment and reconcile approved runs, evidence hashes, decisions and board snapshots within agreed recovery objectives.

gaps.title: SLOs, capacity, inference audit and cost controls are not demonstrated
gaps.acceptance: Publish agreed SLOs and load results at target volume; alerts fire on seeded failures; inference records identify tenant/user, model/version, time, evidence and protected prompt/response references under a retention policy.

gaps.title: Test isolation and stale local pointers remediated; broader integration controls remain open
gaps.acceptance: Running the complete suite leaves production/local-business pointers unchanged; interrupted writes cannot corrupt pointers; a clean test harness creates its required directories before importing application configuration.
